cards.quote: Claudia Crosio, a distinguished researcher with an impressive track record, shared her experiences and insights from her tenure at the prestigious Institute of Scientific and Technical Information (ISTI). Crosio, whose ORCID ID is 0000-0003-2452-1145, has made significant contributions to various fields, and her work at ISTI has been nothing short of remarkable. During her time at ISTI, Crosio was part of a team that focused on cutting-edge research in materials science and nanotechnology.

cards.quote: Data from the European Commission's CORDIS database, which tracks research projects and funding, shows that Crosio has been involved in multiple projects sponsored by the European Union, with Fondazione Santa Lucia listed as a participating organization.
